description: List installed plugins (installedOnly=true) or search the plugin catalog (Modrinth, Hangar) of a Minecraft plugin server (Paper, Spigot, Purpur, Folia, Velocity, Waterfall), e.g. EssentialsX or LuckPerms. Results carry provider, projectId and the installation state. Page with offset/nextOffset. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: list_gameserver_plugins
title: List Game Server Plugins
